name: calendar-direct-default
description: A new install, with no setting of its own for Send Safety: createEvent and createTask without skipReview add the event and the task at once (the block of skipReview for events and tasks starts off on a new install), with eventId or taskId, calendarId and the dates in the result; updateEvent accepts the eventId, and listEvents and listTasks show both. createEvent with skipReview: false still opens the dialog, which Escape closes without creating anything. Mail keeps its block: sendMail with skipReview is refused and nothing reaches the local SMTP sink.
